//: Claude Skills Framework — Project-level Claude Code settings
//note: This file is committed to git. Personal overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

PreToolUse.//: GUARD: Block edits to locked API contract after Gate 1 approval

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *"api-contract.md"* ]]; then if grep -q "LOCKED" AI_DOCS/memory/gate-status.md 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCKED: api-contract.md is LOCKED after Gate 1 approval. Use change-request skill to modify." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'

PostToolUse.//: AUTO-FORMAT: Run Prettier on edited TypeScript/JavaScript/CSS files

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [[ "$FILE_PATH" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|css|scss|json)$ ]]; then if command -v npx &>/dev/null && [ -f node_modules/.bin/prettier ] 2>/dev/null; then npx prettier --write "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; exit 0'

PostToolUse.//: LINT: Run ESLint fix on edited TypeScript/JavaScript files

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [[ "$FILE_PATH" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then if command -v npx &>/dev/null && [ -f node_modules/.bin/eslint ] 2>/dev/null; then npx eslint --fix "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; exit 0'

Stop.//: VERIFY: Check for uncommitted AI_DOCS changes before session ends

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -d AI_DOCS ]; then changes=$(git diff --name-only AI_DOCS/ 2>/dev/null | head -5); untracked=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard AI_DOCS/ 2>/dev/null | head -5); if [ -n "$changes" ] || [ -n "$untracked" ]; then echo "WARNING: Uncommitted AI_DOCS changes detected:" >&2; [ -n "$changes" ] && echo "Modified: $changes" >&2; [ -n "$untracked" ] && echo "Untracked: $untracked" >&2; echo "Consider committing memory files before ending session." >&2; fi; fi; exit 0'

SessionStart.//: CONTEXT: Remind Claude of project state on every session start

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f CLAUDE.md ]; then echo "CLAUDE.md found — project context available."; fi; if [ -f AI_DOCS/memory/task.md ]; then echo "Current tasks:"; head -30 AI_DOCS/memory/task.md 2>/dev/null; fi; if [ -f AI_DOCS/memory/gate-status.md ]; then echo "Gate status:"; head -20 AI_DOCS/memory/gate-status.md 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0'
